div.p: Your account has been created successfully. You can now log in.

t.script: (function(){ // new_user_info is passed from the controller var newUser = ; var lastConnectedUsers = localStorage.getItem("web.lastConnectedUser"); lastConnectedUsers = lastConnectedUsers ? JSON.parse(lastConnectedUsers) : []; // Remove any existing entry for this user lastConnectedUsers = lastConnectedUsers.filter(function(u) { return u.userId != newUser.userId; }); // Add new user at the beginning of the array lastConnectedUsers.unshift(newUser); // Limit the list to the 5 most recent users localStorage.setItem("web.lastConnectedUser", JSON.stringify(lastConnectedUsers.slice(0, 5))); })();
